PROBE_UNRUNNABLE.rule: §10, §10.3: the observation harness cannot run -> ENVIRONMENT (the only probe outcome that may route there)

PROBE_INVALID_SPEC.rule: §10: INVALID_SPEC -> PLAN / INTEGRATION. INTEGRATION: §12 checks 2, 6 and 9 establish contract->spec integrity and probe availability before plan freeze, so a spec that reaches a probe unevaluable is a harness integration fault; §14: PROBE_INVALID is a hard blocker

CONTRACT_UNSATISFIED.rule: §10.3: CANDIDATE, UNSATISFIED -> DEVELOPER; §10.1: failure is ContractSatisfaction UNSATISFIED, never a raw verdict

SUBJECT_ABSENT_AT_CANDIDATE.rule: §10.3 (V2-001): CANDIDATE, admitted obligation, required subject absent -> DEVELOPER: the admitted implementation did not establish the subject the proof requires

PRECONDITION_BROKEN.rule: §10.3, §13: PARENT, PRESERVE or VERIFY over a required subject that is absent -> PRECONDITION_BROKEN, PLAN; §14: a hard plan blocker

PLAN_CONTRADICTION.rule: §13: the parent cannot be reconciled with the plan's own record (a PRESERVE measured UNSATISFIED whose introducing story committed) -> PLAN; §14: a hard plan blocker; owner decision (P2 review): never retryable, so it consumes no budget

POST_MERGE_REGRESSION.rule: §26, §10.3: POST_MERGE, UNSATISFIED -> a regression after merge, INTEGRATION

POST_MERGE_SUBJECT_LOST.rule: §10.3 (V2-001): POST_MERGE, a subject verified at the candidate is gone -> INTEGRATION

NON_CONTROLLER_SIGNAL.rule: §9.3, §10.3 (V2-003): the probe executed and the subject's process ended by a signal the controller did not send. The evidence establishes only that the controller did not send it — not whether the product, the operating system, a resource limit or another actor did — so DEVELOPER would invent product causality and ENVIRONMENT would repeat the defect V2-003 removes; INTEGRATION is the fail-closed owner of an executed proof whose causal reading cannot be established, and it is never retryable: a retry would measure the same thing

MISSING_CREDENTIAL.rule: §22 + owner decision (P1 review): a missing credential is execution configuration -> ENVIRONMENT; whether it is retried is the resolved execution policy's decision

INVALID_CREDENTIAL.rule: §22: MUST NOT be retryable (D-006); owner decision (P1 review): a rejected, revoked or wrong credential is execution configuration, not provider failure -> ENVIRONMENT

PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.rule: §22 + owner decision (P1 review): a provider owns a failure only through a provider-side code — the provider is unavailable

UNKNOWN.rule: §22: a non-AISEF error flattens to UNKNOWN; §15: cause undetermined -> INTEGRATION, never DEVELOPER

retry_count: not in the taxonomy — the resolved execution policy (RunSpec / project / evaluation configuration) supplies it

rfc_table_comparison.detail: equals the RFC §10 and §10.3 tables on 48 (point, outcome, role) rows, polarity-symmetric
